summary: SiteOpportunity manages opportunities associated with a site, including responses, headings, descriptions, sorting, and web page flags. It supports CRUD operations and handles workflow for displaying, updating, and deleting site opportunities with business validations.
purpose: To represent and manage individual opportunity records related to a site, providing structured data for UI display and business logic enforcement.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order of opportunity display; -1 used for blank sort order.

fields.name: DescriptionFormatted
fields.description: Formatted display description, uses alternate if enabled.

fields.name: WebPage
fields.description: True if entry is a web page.

fields.name: HeaderChanged
fields.description: True if header category changes between entries.

workflows.name: Add SiteOpportunity
steps: Add parameters: SiteID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder.

workflows.name: Update SiteOpportunity
steps: Ensure ID is not zero and Response is valid.
Add parameters: SiteOpportunitiesID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder.

workflows.name: Fill List
steps: Map fields: ID, SiteID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder, Description, DescriptionAlt.
If UseAltLanguageFields, set DescriptionFormatted from DescriptionAlt.
Handle header changes via HeaderChanged flag.
Handle WebPage flag if Description matches Resources.WEB_PAGE.

business_rules: Response must not be blank to add or update.
SortOrder set to -1 is treated as blank (displayed as empty string).
HeaderChanged flag set if HeadingID differs from last processed entry.
WebPage flag set if Description matches predefined constant.
validations: IsValid: Response cannot be blank; error message added if validation fails.
calculations: ResponseFormatted: HTML translation of newlines in Response.
SortOrderFormatted: Displayed as empty string if SortOrder is -1; otherwise, as string.
conditions: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use DescriptionAlt as DescriptionFormatted.
If HeadingID changes, HeaderChanged is true and counts are reset.
If Description equals Resources.WEB_PAGE, WebPage is true.
system_behavior: CRUD operations (Add, Update, Delete) executed via stored procedures and parameterized SQL.
UI may display alternate language fields per session setting.
Header management prevents repeated entries and supports numbered codes.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for database access and message logging.
Resources constants for handling special descriptions.
exceptions: Cannot add/update opportunity if Response is blank (returns validation error).
content_gaps: No UI code or specific screen layout provided.
No description of error handling beyond validation.
No information about SiteOpportunitiesCopy beyond commented code.
